children.counts: Slow count of 1-2 for inward and outward foot positions.
children.game_version: Twist-and-shuffle circle game matching hand patterns with a partner.

seniors.counts: Simple 1-2 rhythm matching foot twisting motions.
seniors.seated_version: Perform the interactive hand movements and inward-outward twisting of the feet from a comfortable seated position.
seniors.standing_version: Execute foot shuffling and twisting with light balance support if needed at a steady, slow pace.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Maintained at a natural slower pace with modest foot rotational range.

learning_units.description: Learn the foot shuffling and inward/outward twisting movement inspired by Siva Samoa.

social_formats.description: Informal paired or group interaction between men and women during seasonal community celebrations.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Interactive style of hand movements between man and woman.
movement_profile.footwork: Shuffling and twisting of the feet inward and outward.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Informal group or partner placement during village festivities.
movement_profile.partnering: Interactive hand movement exchange between male and female dancers.

signature_moves.description: Footwork where the feet shuffle and twist in and out, echoing the Siva Samoa style.
signature_moves.name: Foot shuffling and twisting

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Slower and unhurried compared to fast-paced Polynesian forms.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid rushing the tempo or performing high-impact rapid movements, as the dance is grounded in a slower, deliberate pace.

music_profile.sound_description: A generally slower, measured Rotuman vocal and lyrical accompaniment suited for informal community dancing.

basic_steps: Twist and shuffle feet inward and outward in a steady, measured tempo.
Execute hand gestures interactively between male and female dancers.
teaching.formation: Informal social arrangement between male and female dancers.
teaching.level_notes: Accessible to beginners and popular among older generations due to its deliberate tempo.
